# Toastmasters Aachen e. V.

Toastmasters Aachen e. V. is a bilingual German/English non-profit public-speaking and leadership club in Aachen, Germany.

## Key information

- Domain: https://aachen-toastmasters.de
- Contact: info@aachen-toastmasters.de
- Location: Digital Church Aachen, Jülicher Straße 72a, 52070 Aachen, Germany
- Meetings: every Tuesday at 19:00, alternating weekly between German and English
- Guests: visitors are welcome to attend free of charge and do not need to register

## Website languages

German pages use root-level routes. English equivalents are under `/en/`. The printable English flyer is available at `/flyer`.

## Club offering

- Guided public-speaking education through Toastmasters Pathways
- Impromptu speaking practice through Table Topics
- Constructive speech evaluation and feedback
- Leadership development through meeting and club roles
